name: Gray SMS – Complete SMS, Order & User Notifications
author: graywp

sections.description:
Gray SMS is a lightweight and powerful SMS plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. It allows store owners to automatically send SMS notifications to Woocommerce customers about their orders and also send individual SMS messages directly from the WordPress admin dashboard.

The plugin supports multiple SMS providers, giving you flexibility and reliability for business communication.

🌍 Supported SMS Providers

Twilio – Global cloud communications platform
https://www.twilio.com

Khudebarta SMS Gateway – Reliable SMS API service
https://khudebarta.com

You can switch between providers from the plugin settings.

🚀 Features

🔔 WooCommerce Order SMS Notifications
Automatically send SMS when:
– A new order is placed
– Order status changes to Processing, Completed, Cancelled, Refunded, or On-hold

🧩 Custom SMS Templates
Use dynamic tags:
{customer_name}
{order_id}
{order_total}
{product_list}
{site_url}

📱 Single SMS Sender
Send SMS to any phone number directly from the WordPress admin.

⚙️ Provider Switch System
Easily switch between Twilio and Khudebarta.

🔐 Secure storage of API credentials

🪶 Lightweight and developer-friendly code

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party SMS providers to send messages.

Twilio

Service Name: Twilio
Website: https://www.twilio.com
Purpose: Sending SMS notifications
Data Sent: Phone number, SMS content
Privacy Policy: https://www.twilio.com/legal/privacy

Khudebarta

Service Name: Khudebarta SMS Gateway
Website: https://khudebarta.com
API Endpoint: http://portal.khudebarta.com:3775/sendtext
Purpose: Sending SMS notifications
Data Sent: Phone number, SMS content
Privacy Policy: https://khudebarta.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → SMS Gateway.
  4. Choose your SMS provider (Twilio or Khudebarta).
  5. Enter API credentials.
  6. Enable order SMS notifications.
  7. Customize the SMS template and save changes.
sections.faq:
Do I need an SMS provider account?

Yes. You must create an account with Twilio or Khudebarta to use their SMS API.

Can I customize the SMS message?

Yes. You can use variables like {customer_name}, {order_id}, {order_total}, {product_list}, and {site_url}.

Where do I get API credentials?

From your SMS provider dashboard:
Twilio → Console Dashboard
Khudebarta → API section in your account panel

Does this plugin send data to other services?

Yes. SMS data (phone number and message content) is sent only to the selected SMS provider for message delivery.
